featured.title: stayAwakeBot
featured.description: Supply-chain security scanner (saw) that hunts self-propagating packages in repos, lockfiles, and dependency trees — then remediates by PR and gates CI.
highlights: Detects worm-infected packages across repos, lockfiles, and installed dependency trees
Auto-remediation through pull requests, never rewriting history
One-command CI gate (saw guard) with SHA-pinned GitHub Actions workflow
Published on PyPI and GHCR with SLSA provenance and SBOM attestations

featured.title: Research Assistant Model
featured.description: Local-first AI research pipeline: retrieves papers from four scholarly APIs, ranks and clusters them with embeddings, and synthesizes insights into cited reports.
highlights: Multi-source retrieval from OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and CrossRef
Embedding-backed deduplication, ranking, and HDBSCAN clustering
Fully local LLM inference via Ollama, with OpenAI and Anthropic providers
Markdown/HTML/PDF reports with BibTeX, APA, MLA, and Chicago citation export
